collection.title: Renault Koleos 2008 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Renault Koleos 2008 to 2016 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
